City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
OCTOBER 11, 2018 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
EDCO Waste and Recycling Update. Presenters Bob Hill, Director of Recycling, Jamie Symons, Sustainability Manager, and Margo Cobian, City Representative.
B.
Protecting California’s Coast from New Offshore Drilling. Presenter Brady Bradshaw, Oceana.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS/PUBLIC COMMENT Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items.
5.
APPROVAL OF SEPTEMBER 13, 2018 MEETING MINUTES
ITEM 5 Meeting Minutes: 09/13/2018
6.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
Update on Single Use Plastic Straws Distribution by Request Only and Assembly Bill (AB) 1884. Erik Steenblock, Environmental Programs Manager.
6A_AGENDA REPORT - Update on Single Use Plastic Straw Distribution by Request Only
6A_ATTACHMENT 1 - EC Report & Recommendation on Plastic Straws
6A_ATTACHMENT 2 - Assembly Bill 1884
B.
Update on Environmental Commission 2018-2019 Work Plan Goal #9 – Invasive Species Management. Commissioner Lyndes and Commissioner Novy.
6B_AGENDA REPORT Invasive Species
7.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan – October 2018 Update. Erik Steenblock, Environmental Programs Manager.
1.
Approve 2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan – October 2018 Update.
7A_AGENDA REPORT - Work Plan October 2018 Update
7A_ATTACHMENT 1 - 2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan - October Update
8.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS (Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items)
A.
Environmental Event Series. Commission Chair, James Wang
1.
Establish and Environmental Commission Subcommittee to evaluate the Proposed Environmental Event Series, and to Develop a Recommendation to include more definition of a) schedule, b) budget, c) presenters.
8A _ AGENDA REPORT - Environmental Series_Chair Wang
9.
UPDATE ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF

DISCUSSION OF AGENDA ITEMS FOR FUTURE MEETINGS (Commissioners may add future agenda items with consensus of two or more Commissioners)
11.
ADJOURNMENT
